authorization: User instruction: 那就找有獲利潛力的模型; research-only continuation of full reset
historical_exposure: ALL_2023_2026_EXPOSED; THIS IS NOT AN INDEPENDENT HOLDOUT OR CONFIRMATORY TEST
motivation: Test diversification and slow trends, rather than retuning the previously observed residual-reversal winner. Parameters below are new human-readable research choices, not approved production rules.
liquidity: mean of latest 20 turnover_ntd observations including signal >=50000000
history_validity: 61 consecutive TWSE sessions of present positive internally consistent OHLC; finite nonnegative turnover; no close-to-close jump above the quality threshold

scores.TREND_PULLBACK: -(close[t]/close[t-3]-1), require positive score AND close[t]>mean(last60 closes) AND close[t]/close[t-60]-1>0
scores.LOW_VOL_TREND: -sample_stdev(last20 daily returns EXCLUDING signal daily return), require positive stdev AND close[t]>mean(last60 closes) AND close[t]/close[t-60]-1>0

execution: Signal after close, equal-weight next session OPEN, exit CLOSE entry_index+horizon, no overlap; first eligible signal after prior exit; no forced year-end close. Annual schedules reset independently. No signal-time outcome filtering or replacement.
benchmark: At each model signal, equal weight ALL same-day base-eligible PIT electronics tickers at the same entry/exit. Descriptive matched control, not an investable index. Its missing constituents censor the whole benchmark basket.
invalid_future_outcome: Retain selected tickers and intended dates, reserve full interval, mark CENSORED with reason. Never substitute another ticker or treat an unknown outcome as cash. Complete-case metrics are descriptive; any censored model basket blocks potential classification. Also show total-loss lower bound, not a fabricated point estimate.
unfillable_entry: Entry session has high==low: censor, never assume a limit-locked fill
cost_application: Subtract aggregate cost ONCE at exit of each completed equal-weight basket; do not count cost scenarios as separately optimized models
evaluation: 2023,2024,2025 separately with outcomes entirely contained in the calendar year; 2024+2025 combined is descriptive, no parameter selection on any year

potential_screen.label: HISTORICAL_POTENTIAL_ONLY_NOT_ACCEPTED
potential_screen.inference: No significance or robust-winner claim. All past searches count as exposure. No future/pristine data available. Passing this heuristic only nominates future shadow observation.

limitations: New hypotheses informed by exposed historical study; no claim that preregistration restores independence
